KEY TRANSFORMATION INITIATIVES & BUSINESS IMPACT

Operational Excellence & Decision Intelligence: Combined Lean Six Sigma, Process Mining, AI-driven analytics to eliminate 40%

operational inefficiencies, strengthen governance, accelerate decision-making & generate $10M+ measurable business value.

AI-Powered CX Transformation: Implemented Google CCAI, Conversational AI, Agent Assist and GenAI solutions, reducing AHT by

up to 28%, increasing FCR to 76%, improving CSAT by up to 20 points, and delivering up to 3.2x ROI.

GenAI-Powered Employee Services: Deployed a Virtual HR Assistant automating 70%+ HR queries, reducing email traffic by 60%,

lowering ticket volumes by 40%, and enabling 24x7 self-service support.

Insurance Claims Transformation: Led AI-driven claims transformation spanning FNOL, adjudication, fraud detection, workflow automation, and IDP (OCR/ML), improving cycle time by 30%, SLA by 42%, achieving 94% first-pass accuracy & delivering 5.6x ROI.

Order-to-Cash (O2C): Enabled RPA-led order fulfillment transformation, reducing processing time by 62.5%, improving accuracy by

10%, increasing inventory turnover by 40%, and enhancing customer satisfaction.

Procure-to-Pay (P2P): Automated procurement operations across four regions using RPA, OCR and analytics, reducing cycle time by

48%, decreasing invoice mismatches from 17% to 4%, and delivering 225% ROI.

Record-to-Report (R2R): Automated 88% of journal entries, reduced close cycles by 42%, cut reconciliation backlogs by 84%, and

achieved significant annual cost avoidance through intelligent controls and reporting.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Manager - Enterprise AI and Digital Transformation

ARYA CONSULTANCY SERVICES

July’ 25 - Present

Executive scope Lead enterprise-wide AI and digital transformation strategy across BFSI, GBS/GCC and Shared Services, advising CXOs on Enterprise AI Strategy, Target Operating Models, Transformation Portfolio Governance, AI adoption, investment prioritization, and measurable business value realization.

Leadership Highlights

Define Enterprise AI Strategy, Transformation Roadmaps, Target Operating Models and AI Operating Models aligned with

business priorities.

Govern Transformation Portfolio, Investment Governance, Steering Commitee, Benefits Realization & enterprise AI adoption. Lead enterprise transformation governance through executive steering committees, technology governance boards, portfolio

reporting, executive dashboards, RAID management, investment oversight, and benefits realization.

Direct AI operating model modernization integrating people, processes, technology & data to accelerate digital transformation. Drive executive advisory, discovery workshops, strategic solutioning, proposal development & enterprise transformation

consulting.

Designed executive dashboards for portfolio health, transformation KPIs, decision support and governance reporting.

Senior Manager - Lean Digital Transformation

GENPACT

Mar’ 22 - July’ 25

Executive scope

Directed enterprise transformation programs across global BFSI operations, leading AI-enabled business transformation, operating model modernization, process optimization, governance, advanced analytics and executive stakeholder engagement.

Leadership Highlights

Ledenterprise Transformation Office (TMO) governance & transformation portfolio prioritization. Managed governance cadence across PMO, portfolio, and executive steering reviews. Established enterprise RAID governance (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), ensuring ownership, mitigation tracking,

executive visibility, and timely resolution across global transformation programs.

Defined governance pathways for enterprise transformation reviews, approvals, and investment decisions. Directed operating model redesign, business capability transformation, process mining and decision intelligence initiatives Enabled AI-driven automation, analytics & digital modernization improving operational efficiency &customer outcomes.

Associate Manager - Business Transformation

ACCENTURE

Mar’ 17 - Mar’22

Executive scope Led global enterprise transformation consulting engagements advising Fortune 500 clients on digital strategy, Enterprise AI readiness, Target Operating Models, automation strategy, governance and enterprise transformation roadmaps.

Key Achievements

Conducted enterprise transformation assessments, business capability mapping and Target Operating Model design. Led executive workshops, AI discovery sessions, operating model assessments, and digital maturity assessments. Defined Enterprise Architecture alignment, automation strategy and transformation blueprints supporting strategic business objectives. Established Transformation CoEs, governance frameworks, knowledge management and enterprise performance reporting. Delivered enterprise AI, automation, Lean Six Sigma & operational excellence initiatives generating measurable business value.

Manager - Quality and Process Improvement

US TECH SOLUTIONS

Apr’ 15 - Feb’ 17

Executive scope Led enterprise quality, governance, and operational transformation initiatives delivering process optimization, compliance excellence, performance improvement, and business transformation across global operations. Key Achievements

Directed enterprise process transformation using Lean Six Sigma, Value Stream Mapping, RCA and continuous improvement. Governed enterprise quality, compliance, risk and ISO management systems. Led cross-functional transformation initiatives improving operational maturity, productivity and customer outcomes.

Assistant Manager - Delivery Excellence

HCL TECHNOLOGIES

May’ 10 - Mar’ 15

Executive scope Led enterprise operational excellence, governance and process transformation initiatives improving business performance, customer experience and service delivery excellence.

Key Achievements

Led cross-functional teams of 160+ resources through KPI governance, continuous improvement and operational excellence. Led cross-functional teams delivering process optimization, performance improvement and service quality transformation. Established governance frameworks driving continuous improvement and operational maturity.

Team Lead - Delivery Excellence

WIPRO

Oct’ 04 - Apr’10

Executive scope Led service delivery, governance and operational transformation initiatives strengthening customer experience, business performance and organizational capability across global operations.

Key Achievements

Promoted twice based on high performance and leadership. Led service delivery, KPI governance, customer experience improvement and continuous process transformation. Built foundational expertise in business operations, process excellence and people leadership. Managed service delivery, governance, KPI management, and continuous improvement initiatives. Improved customer experience, operational performance, and delivery excellence through structured transformation programs. Built foundational expertise in enterprise operations, governance, process transformation, and people leadership.
